name: Deliver the Shipment
summary: After Driftwood, Watcher Biggs asks you to carry supplies to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep while his wagon is repaired.

sections.title: A Last Delivery for Biggs
sections.body: Watcher Biggs packs the key supplies rescued from the ogre attacks for you to carry. He stays behind to repair the wagon. Nethergarde Keep lies in the Blasted Lands' northern hills and watches over the Dark Portal. Biggs sends you east along the road, then south into the Blasted Lands where it branches. At the next fork, take the left turn and stay wary.

sections.title: At Nethergarde
sections.body: Quartermaster Lungertz is startled when you arrive with a package from Biggs' caravan. The keep had given up the caravan and Biggs for lost. Lungertz thanks you and hopes the supplies include Azoran Crystals, a reagent the keep badly needs and is running low on.

faq.q: Who sends the shipment to Nethergarde?
faq.answer: Watcher Biggs packed the key supplies rescued from the ogre attacks while he stays behind to repair the wagon.

faq.q: Where does this shipment need to go?
faq.answer: You carry the supplies to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands' northern hills.

faq.q: What comes directly before this delivery?
aliases: what quest comes before deliver the shipment

faq.q: What route leads from the swamp to the keep?
faq.answer: Follow the road east, then turn south into the Blasted Lands where it branches. At the next fork, take the left turn.

faq.q: What is Nethergarde Keep watching over?
aliases: why is nethergarde in blasted lands
faq.answer: Nethergarde Keep watches over the Dark Portal.
